impression_before_control_labels: A poised museum staff member in an ivory waistcoat exchanges a small cream note with a suited visitor beneath an open art catalogue. The surrounding formal guests, monumental portrait, staff and bright workroom provide a believable public cultural event. Her face remains the strongest focal point; the hidden hand transaction is readable at native scale and still discernible in the whole thumbnail.
whole_image_strengths: The same paper connects both recipients, giving the lower gesture a concrete result rather than merely a mysterious hand pose.
The catalogue works as an actual physical screen from surrounding guests, while the viewer sees beneath it.
The reference-guided face, staff badge, formal crowd and museum workroom belong to one coherent event.
whole_image_weaknesses: Her visible attention remains toward the suited man rather than clearly greeting a third visitor; the intended divided public/hidden attention is weaker than the authored scenario.
The guest gaze cannot be separated confidently between the upper catalogue and lower card.
The room retains substantial warm gold and reception light; the color-only inspiration is locally visible as warm subject against cooler walls/workroom, but not a uniformly cool environment.

control_calibration.technical_binding: Exact frozen controls and audited prompt were transported with the actual reference attachment.
control_calibration.sensual_perceived: A subtle supporting attractive presence through face, bearing and tailored waistcoat, consistent with the intended supporting direction; the event remains central.
control_calibration.fetish_perceived: No distinct added erotic fixation is observable.
control_calibration.surreal_perceived: Ordinary physical museum space and interactions.
control_calibration.creativity_perceived: The museum-liaison concept remains close to its independent draft; the post-core change is local color organization.

claim_limits: Actual espionage identity, allegiances, note contents, secrecy to every person, consent, motives, prior/later actions and successful information communication cannot be established from this still image.
overall_strict_case: FAIL; the image strongly supports the staged public-role/hidden-transfer concept, but the attention relation fails the predeclared full case.
